name: your-turn
description: Read-only inbox view of what the current Codex chat is doing and the decisions it makes.

interface.shortDescription: See what the agent is doing and why
interface.longDescription: Ends every turn with short Outcome and Next step lines, and a Decision line for each real choice, that the local dashboard at http://localhost:8787 turns into an inbox of your chats.
defaultPrompt: End your answers in the Your Turn handoff format.
